Maya Chen: Heads-up: BigCorp is insisting on RLHF-style evals as a condition for GA on Dedicated. They want the run on our infra and a hard pass/fail.
Liam O'Connor: Clarify: do they send the reward model + harness and expect us to execute it?
Maya Chen: Yes, reward model + small labeled holdout. They've signed TPA but still want runs in their Dedicated tenancy.
Raj Patel: This is non-trivial. Proposal: (1) normal onboarding bench (perf + basic safety), (2) tenant-isolated RLHF run with ephemeral GPU quota, (3) aggregated metrics only returned, (4) pin model entry until re-eval window.
Sophia Varela: Cost + schedule concern: RLHF runs can take many GPU-hours. We need a timebox (e.g., 10 days) and a charged pass-through for customer-covered runs.
Liam O'Connor: Draft pass criteria idea:
- Functional: core intent coverage >= 99%
- Reward-delta <= 0.03 vs customer baseline (higher is better)
- Safety: automated tox checks + manual review for top N failures
- Perf: 95th latency within Dedicated SLO or pay-for-burst
- Ops: RLHF run <= M GPU-hours (TBD)
Raj Patel: Ops constraints: run in tenant-isolated k8s namespace, scrub volumes/logs, delete reward model after run. No long-term storage of customer models.
Maya Chen: Add product metadata flags to catalog entry: `rlhf_required`, `rlhf_pass_ts`, `pinned_until`, `rlhf_owner`. Console should surface these and the chargeback status.
Liam O'Connor: If harness flaky, allow `provisional-GA` limited to non-critical routes for 14 days while we troubleshoot.
Sophia Varela: I'll prototype pricing and chargeback options; aim to present numbers by Thu EOD.
Raj Patel: Rough infra estimate: 2 days design, ~1 week provisioning (namespaces + quota + scrub), +3 eng-days for integration tests.
Maya Chen: Action items:
- Raj: infra design doc + estimate (due Tue)
- Liam: formalize RLHF pass spec and sample size (due Wed)
- Sophia: pricing/chargeback proposal (due Thu EOD)
- Maya: onboarding playbook + metadata field PR (due Fri)

Maya Chen: I'll loop in legal after next sync. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to align owners. :calendar:
